backtick-runs.notes: Generated. Balanced raw delimiters of every length 1-40.

bidi-mixed.notes: RTL and LTR mixed within paragraphs, tables and lists.

deep-nesting-10k.notes: Generated. 10,000 levels in markup, code and math; Typst's parser stops at depth 256.

deep-nesting-64.notes: Generated. Deep but legal nesting mixing markup, code and math.

hostile-deep-content.notes: Content nested 100,000 deep by a loop. Native typst overflows its stack (SIGSEGV) within the limits; in the engine the worker traps and is replaced.

hostile-html-attributes.notes: Event handlers, URL attributes, CSS that loads or leaves the document's box, `is`, data-* and clobbering ids.

hostile-html-elements.notes: html.elem script, style, iframe, object, embed, base, meta refresh, forms, template, noscript, dialog, SVG script/foreignObject/animation, MathML.

hostile-huge-dimensions.notes: A page 1 km wide, 10,000 pt text, a 50,000 pt stroke.

hostile-image-url.notes: A tracking pixel. Images come from the virtual file system only.

hostile-import-local.notes: Natively: package not found. The engine: not allowed.

hostile-import-unlisted.notes: Natively typst can't get it: the validator runs it without network (failed to download), and the registry wouldn't have it (package not found). The engine fetches nothing that isn't allowed.

hostile-layout-nonconvergent.notes: Introspection that never converges: Typst stops after five layout attempts.

hostile-links.notes: javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file:, blob:, intent: and protocol-relative links, obfuscated as browsers read them.

hostile-markup-text.notes: Markup in text, raw, math, captions, headings and attribute values must stay text.

expectedErrors: cannot find definition for import env::fetch
hostile-plugin-import.notes: A wasm plugin importing a host function. Re-check on Typst upgrades (PLAN.md §9).

hostile-plugin-loop.notes: A wasm plugin that loops forever; plugins run without a fuel limit, so only the watchdog stops it.

hostile-read-absolute.notes: Reads /etc/passwd. Only files in the virtual file system exist.

hostile-read-url.notes: A file: URL is a path to Typst; nothing fetches it.

large-1mb.notes: Generated. ~1,000,000 UTF-16 units of education-shaped blocks with an outline, footnotes and refs.

expectedErrors: the character `#` is not valid in code
markdown-habits.notes: Every Markdown habit we know of. `#` headings, `$` currency and HTML fail to parse; most of the rest is legal Typst that renders wrongly.

memory-bomb-array.notes: Array doubling. Native typst aborts when allocation fails under the memory limit.

pages-500.notes: A short loop that lays out 500 pages.

runaway-cpu-loop.notes: 400 million iterations; nothing in Typst stops it. Needs the engine watchdog.

runaway-exponential-recursion.notes: 2^40 calls with distinct arguments, so memoization can't help.

single-line-200k.notes: Generated. One 200,000-character paragraph on a single line.

table-2000-rows.notes: Generated. 2,000 rows written cell by cell.

truncated-output.notes: A model response cut off mid-table, inside math inside a function call.

zalgo-text.notes: Generated. Up to 50 combining marks per base character.
